title: Who was standing upside down on the ceiling above my climb?
description:
Every Thursday I climb late in an old brick mill, alone, on the machine at the top of the wall. Since my slip last year, nobody holds my rope.

Then one night I looked up from the top hold, and someone was standing on the ceiling. Upside down. One hold closer every week.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Did anyone else notice what colour the chalk on my rope was?
